title: Connection errors: resume the role instead of stopping as unclassified
lead: *Proposed.* Drafted 2026-11-11. Size M. A dropped network connection to a vendor ends a role as `unclassified`, and record 23 makes that stop the run. Twice on 2026-11-10 this threw away a long round that a resume would have kept. This slice classifies the two observed connection failures and resumes the same session. What exactly ork does is open (Q1 to Q3).
findings_note: S268 Grok reviewer lost 46 min to a reqwest send error; S216 Claude implementer lost $5.50 to api_error connection_failed; both unclassified, both needed ork retry.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* Evidence read on 2026-11-11 from the run records and saved candidate fixtures under `~/.local/state/ork/`:

- S268, run `ork-20261110-124242-bc16`: the Grok reviewer (`grok-4.7`) ran from 12:51:58Z to 13:38:08Z (46 minutes, 504,299 tokens) and ended `unclassified`. Its stderr (`fixtures/grok/20261110T133808Z-3801646317/stderr`) ends: `Error: Internal error: "reqwest error stream: error sending request for url (https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/responses)"`. The run stopped; the orchestrator ran `ork retry`, and the reviewer started over.
- S216, run `ork-20261110-123716-4600`: the Claude sonnet implementer ran from 13:15:38Z to 13:21:19Z (cost $5.50) and ended `unclassified`. Its result event (`fixtures/claude/20261110T132119Z-1673783836/stdout`) has `"is_error":true`, `"api_error":"connection_failed"` and the result text `API Error: Couldn't connect through your proxy (ERR_PROXY_TUNNEL) ...`.
- Classification: `grok.go:332` sets `ExitUnclassified` for any non-zero exit that is not out of credits or a permission cancel. `claude.Classify` (`internal/agent/claude/classify.go:19-34`) makes everything that is not ok or denied unclassified and does not read `api_error`. `internal/daemon/runner.go:72-80` and `:180-186` map those to `engine.ExitUnclassified`.
- Fallback: `fallbackExit` (`internal/engine/ledger.go:45-47`) falls back on rate limited, out of credits and error only. Adj 156 (`vendor.fallback-trigger-v2`) keeps record 23 (unclassified stops the slice). Adj 77 (`vendor.unsampled-classes`) allows a class only from a real sample. The two fixtures above are real samples.
- Codex: no connection-failure sample exists. It is out of scope until one does.

Open owner questions (the owner answers before the relay starts; they need an adj record, key `vendor.connection-error`):
- Q1 what a connection error does. (a) a new class `connection`: resume the same session once in the same round after a short wait; if that also fails, treat it as `error` (fall back to the next row per adj 156); a run with no next row pauses with a one-line reason naming the vendor and the error (recommended: keeps the session's work, 46 minutes on S268, and stays inside adj 156). (b) classify it as `error`: the next row starts fresh, with no resume. (c) keep `unclassified` and only name the connection error in the pause reason.
- Q2 the resume budget. (a) one resume after 30 s (recommended). (b) up to three resumes, after 30 s, 60 s and 120 s. (c) another budget.
- Q3 which signals count. (a) only the two sampled ones: Grok stderr containing `reqwest error` and `error sending request`, and a Claude result with `api_error` `connection_failed` (recommended, per adj 77). (b) also a missing result event after a non-zero exit with network words in stderr (unsampled).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestGrokConnection and TestClaudeConnection replay the sampled failures; existing classifier and unclassified regressions remain green.
- TestConnectionFixturesSanitized rejects credential text in the new fixtures.
- TestConnectionRunnerMapping checks both daemon mappings and classified reasons.
- TestConnectionResume checks one 30-second wait, same session and round, successful report and no pause.
- TestConnectionFallback checks two connection failures then the next row.
- TestConnectionPause covers both exhausted resume and empty-session failures with no next row: one-line vendor/error pause, then Retry runs the same row and produces the recovered report without another automatic wait.
- Existing unclassified stop coverage remains green.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Copy the two samples into `testdata/vendors/` as fixtures, without the prompt and report text, and with no credential lines (the Claude result has a `credential_expires_at` field; drop it).
2. Add the class and the two classifiers per Q3.
3. In the round, on the new class, wait (Q2), then resume the role's session once, using the path S275 uses for the shape retry. On a second failure, use the `error` path.
4. Docs (*proposed*): design.md's exit classes and fallback table.
5. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased` (*proposed*).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go vet ./... && go test ./...` exits 0 (ork repeats outside the sandbox).
- `go test -count=1 ./internal/agent/... ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon -run "^(Test(GrokConnection|ClaudeConnection|ConnectionFixturesSanitized|ConnectionRunnerMapping|ConnectionResume|ConnectionFallback|ConnectionPause|GrokBadModelAndAuthStayUnclassified|Classify.*|AuthAndUnclassifiedExitsStillStopTheSlice))$" -v` exits 0 and lists the new tests and relevant regressions.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `go test ./internal/agent/claude -run TestConnectionFixturesSanitized` exits 0 (no credential text in the new fixtures).
- `slicer check` and `adj lint` exit 0; ork also runs tracking checks outside the sandbox.
